context: Negative control. coupon.py already carries a green, behavior-covering test suite in resources/test_coupon.py, so no characterization work is warranted. Tests whether the agent recognizes existing coverage and proceeds, rather than reflexively writing characterization tests because the skill it loaded is about legacy code.

checklist.name: existing_coverage_recognized
checklist.description: The agent finds test_coupon.py, runs it, and states that a green baseline already exists. It does not describe coupon.py as legacy or untested.

checklist.name: no_redundant_characterization
checklist.description: No characterization tests are written for behavior test_coupon.py already pins (unknown code, expiry, exhaustion, minimum order, percentage discount). Adding a duplicate suite fails this item.

checklist.name: no_unnecessary_dependency_breaking
checklist.description: CouponBook's constructor is already injectable, and the agent does not restructure it, extract interfaces, or introduce seams that nothing requires.

checklist.name: stacking_rule_works
checklist.description: A coupon with max_stack refuses to redeem when the order already carries more than that many other coupons, and the rule has its own test written before or alongside the implementation.

checklist.name: existing_tests_unedited
checklist.description: All seven existing tests still pass and none of their assertions were changed. Coupons without a max_stack key keep redeeming as they do today.
